arms.label: Hallmark with its design.md lock

pin.commitNote: skills@1.7.6 records a content hash (skills-lock.json computedHash), not a git commit. treeHash is the binding pin.

arms.methodLine: The design skill installed in this repository is Hallmark (`.agents/skills/hallmark`). Invoke it as `$hallmark` for this screen and follow its process end to end. If the repository root has no `design.md` yet, lock the system after the build (Hallmark's `lock the system`) so later screens share it. Report the skill steps you ran in your final message.
setup: Workspace: prepare-design-pilot arm A without TASK.md and PROMPT.md, plus the neutral AGENTS.md and a .gitignore; git init and one starter commit.
Once per --prepare, in <out>/.skill-cache/hallmark-lock: npx -y skills@1.7.6 add nutlope/hallmark --skill hallmark -a codex -y --copy (or --skill-dir hallmark-lock=<a saved copy of the pinned tree>).
Refuse unless the installed tree hash equals pin.treeHash.
Copy the tree to .agents/skills/hallmark in every hallmark-lock workspace.

pin.note: engineRevision (the catalog hash of the skill payload) is the binding pin; --prepare refuses a checkout whose catalog differs. The baseline round runs from a checkout at the pinned revision; the re-measure round re-pins and records it as an amendment in PROTOCOL.md.

Use the installed StyleSeed skills and the artifact registry. Preserve the existing library/theme; provisional resolver settings do not approve replacing them. setup: Workspace: prepare-design-pilot arm B (arm A plus the StyleSeed skill payload under .agents/skills/ and the provisional .styleseed/ registry) without TASK.md and PROMPT.md, plus the neutral AGENTS.md and a .gitignore; git init and one starter commit.
Refuse unless the copied catalog's engineRevision equals pin.engineRevision. The payload is a physical copy; there is no .agents symlink into this repository.
